segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products through direct selling in Canada, Latin America and the United States.
segments.evidence: The results in our Americas segment reflect a continued decline in our North America markets, while our Latin America markets grew year-over-year.

segments.name: Southeast Asia/Pacific
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products through direct selling in Southeast Asia, Australia, New Zealand and other markets.
segments.evidence: Our financial results and key performance indicators for this market, which are included in our Southeast Asia/Pacific segment in this report, were insignificant for 2025.

segments.name: Mainland China
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products in Mainland China through sales employees and independent marketers.
segments.evidence: Long-lived assets in Mainland China consist primarily of property, plant and equipment related to manufacturing, distribution facilities and the Mainland China headquarters.

segments.name: Japan
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products to consumers in Japan through its Brand Affiliates and direct selling network.
segments.evidence: These segments consist of our seven geographic Nu Skin segments—Americas, Southeast Asia/Pacific, Mainland China, Japan, Europe & Africa, South Korea, and Hong Kong/Taiwan—and our two Rhyz segments—Manufacturing and Rhyz Other.

segments.name: Europe & Africa
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products through direct selling in European markets and South Africa.
segments.evidence: We introduced enhancements to the sales performance plan in Europe & Africa starting in March 2025.

segments.name: South Korea
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products to South Korean consumers through its direct selling sales force.
segments.evidence: These segments consist of our seven geographic Nu Skin segments—Americas, Southeast Asia/Pacific, Mainland China, Japan, Europe & Africa, South Korea, and Hong Kong/Taiwan—and our two Rhyz segments—Manufacturing and Rhyz Other.

segments.name: Hong Kong/Taiwan
segments.description: Sells Nu Skin beauty and wellness products through direct selling in Hong Kong, Taiwan and Macau.
segments.evidence: The decline in our Hong Kong/Taiwan segment for 2025 is attributable to macroeconomic issues, which are resulting in less purchasing power for our consumers.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Manufactures dietary supplements, ingredients and packaging and develops personal care products for Nu Skin and other customers.
segments.evidence: Our Rhyz strategic investment arm also includes two additional segments: Manufacturing and Rhyz Other.

segments.name: Rhyz Other
segments.description: Holds Rhyz other investments, including a beauty company selling through digital and retail channels and a DNA assessment company.
segments.evidence: The Rhyz Other segment includes other investments by our Rhyz strategic investment arm.

revenueModel.text: Independent Brand Affiliates and sales employees sell beauty and wellness products directly to consumers, who pay the company for the products they buy.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate in the direct selling channel, primarily utilizing person-to-person marketing to promote and sell our products, including through the use of social and digital platforms.

changes.text: In 2025 the company sold Mavely, a social commerce platform that had been part of the Rhyz Other segment.
changes.evidence: Until January 2025, the Rhyz Other segment additionally included MyFavoriteThings, Inc., dba Mavely, a social commerce platform.

changes.text: In 2023 the company closed its Israel market and renamed the Europe, Middle East and Africa segment Europe & Africa.
changes.evidence: As a result the Europe, Middle East and Africa ("EMEA") segment has been renamed Europe & Africa.
